title: T1498.002 — Network Denial of Service - Reflection Amplification
subtitle: The story shows three reflector families - DNS, NTP, and memcached - being abused against one victim.
aria: T1498.002 - Network Denial of Service - Reflection Amplification

steps.title: Finding open reflectors
steps.caption: The attacker scans for open DNS resolvers, NTP servers, and memcached instances and builds a target list.
steps.defender: exposure scans find these services on your own ranges first.
